definitions.explanation: A note placed at the bottom of a page providing additional information, citations, or explanations for text in the main body.

examples.japanese: {論文|ろんぶん}に{脚注|きゃくちゅう}を{付|つ}ける。
examples.english: To add footnotes to a thesis.

examples.japanese: {詳|くわ}しい{説明|せつめい}は{脚注|きゃくちゅう}を{参照|さんしょう}してください。
examples.english: Please refer to the footnotes for detailed explanations.

examples.japanese: {脚注|きゃくちゅう}に{出典|しゅってん}を{明記|めいき}する。
examples.english: To clearly note the source in a footnote.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {脚|きゃく} (foot, leg) + {注|ちゅう} (note, annotation). Literally "a note at the foot (of the page)."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{脚注|きゃくちゅう}を{付|つ}ける (to add footnotes)
・{脚注|きゃくちゅう}を{参照|さんしょう}する (to refer to footnotes)
・{脚注|きゃくちゅう}{番号|ばんごう} (footnote number)
・{脚注|きゃくちゅう}{形式|けいしき} (footnote format)

RELATED TERMS:
・{注釈|ちゅうしゃく} (annotation, commentary)
・{頭注|とうちゅう} (headnote - note at the top of a page)
・{傍注|ぼうちゅう} (marginal note)
・{出典|しゅってん} (source, reference)
・{引用|いんよう} (quotation, citation)
・{巻末注|かんまつちゅう}/{後注|こうちゅう} (endnote)

ACADEMIC WRITING: In Japanese academic writing, footnotes are essential for proper citation. They may contain {出典|しゅってん} (sources), {補足|ほそく}{説明|せつめい} (supplementary explanations), or {原語|げんご} (original language terms).
